summary: End-to-end verification of the two reported bugs (Bug 1 Google login + Bug 2 chat AI) and the surrounding chat/artifact/image/regenerate/OTP flows on the Supabase-backed backend at https://claus-ai.preview.emergentagent.com. PRIMARY bug (Bug 2) is FIXED: authenticated chat via QA session generates real Mistral answers with no 'Errore di connessione con l\'AI'; usage counter increments correctly by 1 per send (no double count). Bug 1 (Google login) — GIS button renders with a Google iframe (verified inside data-testid='login-google-button') and email OTP flow succeeds against /api/auth/otp/request → transitions to the 6-digit code entry screen without any 502/5xx. Full Google OAuth and full OTP verify not automatable (need real Google account / real inbox). One frontend UX bug found: on OTP request validation error the toast displays literal '[object Object]' instead of a readable message.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr rejects reserved TLDs like .test with 422 (this is correct per RFC; only worth mentioning because current test_credentials.md uses qa@zalvion.test which cannot be used to send a real OTP). Real gmail.com etc. work → 200 {status:'sent'}.

ui_bugs.issue: When /api/auth/otp/request returns 4xx with a FastAPI/Pydantic validation error (body = {detail:[{...}]}), the error toast renders literal '[object Object]' instead of extracting a human-readable message. Reproduce: /login → email 'foo@bar.test' → Invia codice → red toast shows '[object Object]'. Fix: in the catch, coerce err/detail to string (e.g. detail[0].msg || err.message).

action_items: (Optional/low) Fix Login.jsx toast to render backend validation errors as text instead of '[object Object]'. Not blocking — real emails (gmail/outlook/etc.) work fine and reach the OTP-code screen.
(Optional) Consider updating /app/memory/test_credentials.md to use a non-reserved TLD (e.g. qa@zalvion.dev) if anyone ever wants to trigger a real OTP send during automated tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Chat /api/ai/generate: usage increments once per user message (verified via UI counter 1→2→3→5 and via curl showing usage_used unchanged when calling /ai/generate). Double-count fix confirmed.

Google client id alignment (frontend REACT_APP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and backend GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID match: 472113012312-6tkohrse4hgous2gjln957e5i6178gg3.apps.googleusercontent.com) — GIS button now renders its official iframe inside [data-testid='login-google-button'].
Cookies: fetch uses credentials:'include' but the site uses Bearer token in localStorage; no cross-origin cookie errors observed in console.
Console shows expected 401s on /api/auth/me before login — harmless (unauthenticated bootstrap). No 5xx anywhere during testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 6 review scenarios (chat text answer, artifact card + preview panel, image mode → Pollinations img, regenerate, login page render + Google iframe, OTP request → code screen)

test_credentials: Bearer qa_session_supabase_01 (localStorage.claus_token) → user_qa_test / qa@zalvion.test, plan free, 10/day limit. Consumed 5/10 during this run.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing QA session. Note usage_used advanced to ~5/10; main agent can reseed if needed for the next run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary review items PASS on preview URL. Verified: (1) POST /api/ai/generate returns Mistral content with no double usage count; UI chat shows real assistant bubble ('OK.'), no 'Errore di connessione' toast. (2) Artifact flow: 'Creami un contatore in React con + e -' produced [data-testid='artifact-card'], code-artifact-panel auto-opened, live preview iframe rendered a working Contatore with -, reset, + buttons. (3) Image mode toggle [data-testid='image-mode-toggle'] switches composer placeholder to 'Immagine…' and sending 'un gatto astronauta' rendered a full Pollinations (astronaut cat) in the assistant bubble. (4) Regenerate: [data-testid='regenerate-button'] on last assistant message triggered a fresh generation ('Sto pensando…' → new text). (5) /login clears localStorage → renders Google iframe inside [data-testid='login-google-button'] + [data-testid='login-email-button']. Clicking email → filling gmail address → [data-testid='send-code-button'] → POST /api/auth/otp/request 200 → transitions to 'Controlla la tua email' screen with 6-cifre input and 'Verifica e continua' button; success toast 'Abbiamo inviato un codice a 6 cifre a …'. Only defect: validation-error path renders '[object Object]' in toast (minor).
rca of the issue: Bug 2 root cause (per main agent): frontend was calling Pollinations client-side (blocked/failing) → 'Errore di connessione con l\'AI'. Fix: /app/frontend/src/pages/ChatApp.jsx handleSend/handleRegenerate now call generateAI() → POST /api/ai/generate (Mistral, non-streaming, {content}) and no longer double-count usage. Verified in UI. Bug 1 root cause: backend GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID mismatch with frontend GIS client id caused 'token non valido' (audience error). Fix: backend .env GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID aligned to 472113012312-6tkohrse4hgous2gjln957e5i6178gg3.apps.googleusercontent.com. Verified: GIS iframe now renders and /api/auth/google/verify exists; full Google OAuth cannot be completed headlessly.
